title: malus sylvestris subsp. praecox
intro: Malus sylvestris subsp. praecox, commonly known as wild crabapple, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree that is native to Europe and Asia, and is known for its fragrant white flowers and edible fruits. The health benefits of Malus sylvestris subsp. praecox include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including polyphenols, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
